page.overview:
Who is Cremia?

Not to be confused with , a similarly designed character from Ocarina of Time.

If Link helped save the from the , will invite the young Hero of Time to accompany her on the ride to deliver the Milk to the in the night of the Second Day, and claims to be lonely, as she welcomes company. As the have blocked , they ride down the instead. As the intend to steal the special beverage, Link must prevent them from doing so. After they deliver the , will reward him the . If the quest is completed again after obtaining this , will give Link either a or an affectionate hug (something very hardly seen in the main series and is popular among fans). The decision amounts to a random choice with a 50/50 probability for either outcome. If Link fails to defend her Milk, she will dejectedly return home, lamenting that she is a failure of a rancher.

If Link fails to prevent the Ghosts from abducting Romani and their Cows in the First Day, Cremia will become heartbroken, due to not only her business being destroyed from the loss of her specially-bred Cows but also her younger sister being in an unhealthy, disoriented state, along with regret for not listening to her about the dangerous spirits.

Even though some of the citizens of take refuge at Romani Ranch on the night of the , reveals that she knows even they are not safe from the in the (as with the rest of Termina), and sadly accepts the fate that awaits all of the residents. Knowing that they likely will not survive, grants her younger sister, who does not know of the fate that will befall them, the wish to drink for the first time, something she had been denying since she was not an adult yet. Furthermore, she acknowledges as an adult and even promises to make her a to officially signify her younger sister's status as a grown-up. Before heading back to their home, seemingly for one final time, asks her sister to sleep with her in her , to which agrees.
